findings: lake build under the dependent-type carrier model: B-D028 (Mslang.IsMonoAlg, IsEpiAlg, IsSubdirectEmbedding, IsSubdirectProduct, IsomorphicSubdirectEmbeddings) compiled against Mathlib v4.33.1.

Encoding: subdirect product via existence of a subdirect embedding into the product (the paper's second formulation), since the encoding has no literal 'A is a subalgebra of the product'; monomorphisms/epimorphisms are injective/surjective homomorphisms. Opens the formation-theoretic layer in a new Mslang/Formation.lean module.
